support.faq_q1: How do I change my personal information?
support.faq_a1: Go to My Profile → edit icon at the top right. You can change your name, phone number and profile picture.
support.faq_a2: The commission is 10% of your monthly revenue. The first month is free. It is calculated automatically each month in "My Earnings".
support.faq_q3: How do I pay my commission?
support.faq_a3: From "My Earnings" → "Pay now" button. Transfer the amount in USDT TRC20 to the address shown, then paste the transaction hash for confirmation.
support.faq_q4: I can't log in to my account
support.faq_a4: Check your email and password. If you forgot your password, use "Forgot password?" on the login page. Contact support if the problem persists.
support.faq_q5: How do I cancel or change an appointment?
support.faq_a5: From "My appointments", tap the appointment concerned. You can change or cancel it as long as it is not in progress.
support.faq_q6: My commission payment has not been validated
support.faq_a6: Validation takes up to 24–48h. Make sure you submitted the correct transaction hash (TXID). If the delay has passed, contact us with your hash.
support.faq_q7: How do I turn on notifications?
support.faq_a7: Go to your phone settings → Apps → AtlasMove → Notifications → Enable. Then restart the app.
